title: Virtual fundamental classes
summary: Rational intersection theory on Deligne-Mumford stacks of finite type over a field (Gillet-Vistoli cycles and Chow groups, flat pullback, proper pushforward, Vistoli's Gysin maps and bivariant classes, homotopy invariance, Chern classes, intersection products), the comparisons with coarse moduli spaces and Edidin-Graham equivariant Chow groups and the rational degree of zero-cycles, and the Behrend-Fantechi theory: cone stacks, h1/h0, the truncated relative cotangent complex of a morphism of Deligne-Mumford type, the relative intrinsic normal cone of pure dimension, obstruction theories, the virtual fundamental class with its properties, and the perfect obstruction theory of relative spaces of maps from families of prestable curves.
